fields.description:
Operator-approved early removal (pre-1.0 breaking pass #3), 2026-08-12. Source: the DEPRECATION REMOVAL-READINESS SURVEY, comment #11 on childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet (b902-18af-14ed-4da1), Tier 2 item 3. Operator ruling (verbatim): "The two best candidates and the one ready now are all approved for removal." Third and last change of the pass, after checked-unhelpful-tanager and priceless-charred-fruitbat.

## What

Remove the deprecated bare env var `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` (deprecated 1fbfb5c691, shipped v0.11.0; ADR 0057). The per-class `[tool.rebar.llm.model_classes]` slots are the interface; the bare scalar is a SUPERSESSION with a migration window that the operator has now closed early.

## SCOPE NARROWING — the config key `[tool.rebar.llm].model` STAYS

The survey framed this as "REBAR_LLM_MODEL / llm.model". Evidence says only the ENV VAR is removable, and that matches the registry, whose single row (`src/rebar/_deprecations.py:101`) is env-only:

- `rebar.toml` sets `[tool.rebar.llm].model` deliberately and load-bearingly (it pins the provider so provider inference cannot leak to a non-Bedrock default).
- `LLMConfig.model` is read widely across the runtime and is the value model-class resolution falls back to.
- `docs/config.md:320` documents `model` as a live key; only its "env `REBAR_LLM_MODEL`" annotation goes.

So this ticket removes ONE env channel and leaves the config key, the CLI `-c llm.model` override, and the per-step `model:` workflow override untouched.

## Scope (current main)

- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py:92-101` — delete the `_scheduled("env", "REBAR_LLM_MODEL", …)` row and its explanatory comment block; append this removal to the historical-record NOTE.
- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py:~249` — ADD the tombstone `_tomb("env", "REBAR_LLM_MODEL", "the [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] slots", "error")`, directly mirroring the `REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS` row at :249.
- `src/rebar/llm/config.py:529-536` — wire the new tombstone check next to the existing `REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS` check in `LLMConfig.from_env`, the same fail-loud placement (a retired LLM knob fails only when the LLM stack loads; `RemovedInputError` is a `BaseException` so the broad `except Exception` in this method cannot swallow it).
- `src/rebar/llm/config.py:581-597` — delete the warn-when-set block; `:599` — stop reading the env for `model`.
- `src/rebar/llm/config.py:373` — `_llm_str` gains `env_name: str | None`, skipping the env read when `None`, so `model` resolves CLI > config table > default with no env channel.
- `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py:230-250` — delete `_deprecated_bare_model()`; drop the `fallback_default` rung so class precedence becomes CLI > per-class env > config table > built-in default (`:183-189` comment updated).

### Prose/comment sites in `src/` that name the variable (all must move, or AC-1 cannot pass)

`src/rebar/llm/config.py:10` (module env table), `:285` (the `resolve_model` docstring describing `cfg.model` as folding the env read — FACTUALLY FALSE post-removal), `src/rebar/llm/completion.py:70` (says a non-default `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` still wins — also FACTUALLY FALSE post-removal), `src/rebar/llm/gate_context.py:14` (a historical sizing anecdote; reword to past tense, it is a record of why a change was unlandable).

### Test consumers (the blocking risk: they set the env and go through `LLMConfig.from_env`)

After the tombstone lands, ANY test that sets `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` and builds an `LLMConfig` will RAISE `RemovedInputError` instead of resolving. All 15 files that reference the variable must be retargeted to `[tool.rebar.llm].model`, a per-class `REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL`, or the `-c llm.model` override: `tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_deprecation.py` (retargeted to assert the fail-loud tombstone), `test_config_llm.py`, `test_ci_provider_matrix.py`, `test_llm_config_pointer.py`, `test_project_default_provider.py`, `test_llm_config_gate_root.py`, `test_gate_context_seam.py`, `test_bedrock_provider.py`, `test_openai_compatible_provider.py`, `test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover.py`, `test_code_review_per_pass_classes.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_review_output_budget.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_code_review_usage_attribution.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_scoped_ticket_tool.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py`.

### `infra/` (operator-facing, hand-written)

`infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md:334-339` tells operators not to reach for the alias and names `model_classes._deprecated_bare_model`, a symbol this change deletes; `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:170-178` explains why the variable is deliberately not set. Both are reworded to "removed", not "deprecated".

## Registry/tombstone treatment (mirrors precedent)

Deleted row + historical NOTE is the DE7 / ticket-5899 shape. UNLIKE removal #2, this one DOES take a tombstone: the tombstone registry covers `env`/`cfg`/`file` inputs, and the closest precedent — `_tomb("env", "REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS", "REBAR_LLM_MAX_STEPS", "error")`, also a superseded LLM knob checked in `llm.config.from_env` — is `behavior="error"`. Fail-loud is right here because silently ignoring a still-set `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` would quietly change which model every operation runs, i.e. cost and quality, with no signal. Record "operator-approved early removal (pre-1.0 pass #3), 2026-08-12".

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The env var is gone from the resolver and from every prose site that described it as live; checked: `grep -rn REBAR_LLM_MODEL src/rebar` matches ONLY the tombstone row in `_deprecations.py`, its `from_env` check, and the historical-record NOTE (a raw grep, since env names are string literals the LSP cannot resolve).
- [ ] A still-set `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` FAILS LOUD with the migration message rather than being ignored; checked: `REBAR_LLM_MODEL=x rebar review-plan --check` exits non-zero naming the model_classes slots.
- [ ] `[tool.rebar.llm].model`, `-c llm.model` and the per-step `model:` override all still resolve; proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_llm.py`.
- [ ] The deprecation row is deleted and the tombstone added; proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_deprecation_registry.py`.
- [ ] `docs/env-vars.md` is REGENERATED, not hand-edited, and no longer lists the variable; checked: `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py && git diff --exit-code docs/env-vars.md`.
- [ ] Hand-written docs and operator material drop the variable: `docs/config.md`, `docs/llm-framework.md`, `docs/llm-example-configs.md`, `docs/local-dev-env.md`, `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md`, `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md`, `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`. ADR 0057 stays as historical record.
- [ ] No test sets the removed env and then builds an `LLMConfig` (which would now raise); proven by the full `pytest` suite passing.
- [ ] `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` record the removal in the prior passes' table format.
- [ ] Gates green; checked: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the full `pytest` suite.

## Testing

- `make lint` and `make typecheck` — the commit gate.
- `pytest` (full suite); `tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_deprecation.py` covers the deprecation being removed and is retargeted to the tombstone's fail-loud behaviour.
- `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py && git diff --exit-code docs/env-vars.md` — the CI env-registry drift gate.
- `grep -rn REBAR_LLM_MODEL src tests docs infra` — raw grep for the string-literal env name, including the operator-facing `infra/` runbook and compose file.
